new_sources.summary: Chris Wright, author of “ The Mission of God ” joins us to talk about mission. What even is mission? Is it biblical? If it is what does it mean for each of us as followers of Jesus and what does it mean for the churches we each belong to? Chris is an excellent communicator and has thought long and hard about these topics, digging deep into the Bible and seeking to be faithful to what it teaches us. Do check out Chris’s book The Mission of God and his paper on The Church & Integral Mission If you enjoy the conversation do check out Chris Wright's podcast On Mission with Chris Wright Book and Song suggestions from Chris Wright: The Overstory, a novel by Richard Powers Leonard Cohen – Anthem U2
new_sources.title: What even is mission? - A conversation with Chris Wright

new_sources.summary: Childhood sexual, physical, or emotional abuse can result in splitting many aspects of the emotional and rational sides of a person. Commonly the emotions become confused and difficult to name, and the rational side dominates as a survival mechanism. This can be exacerbated by simplistic teaching that suggests people need to choose to act in certain ways and ignore their emotions. Examples of biblical lament provide helpful models of integration between the rational and emotional sides, encouraging the naming of negative emotions before God, turning to God rather than away from God to an abuser.
